Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 28

“Others offer their wealth, their austerity, or their practice as sacrifice, while ascetics of firm vows offer study and knowledge.”

The catalogue keeps widening to include whatever people actually have — money, effort, study. The list is generous, and deliberately avoids naming a single required form.
